Name: UltraSmooth
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#1890ff]UltraSmooth[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Visual Polish, Display Refresh Rate Pacing & Engine Optimizer for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#52c41a]60 / 120 / 144 / 240Hz+ Pacing[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]Smart Debris Stacking[/color]  •  [color=#d48806]Co-op Buffer Expansion[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Overview[/b][/size]
[b]UltraSmooth[/b] is a lightweight client-side companion mod focused on smoother motion, display refresh rate pacing, lower cursor input latency, and improved stability for multiplayer co-op in Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Whether you play at 60 FPS, on standard 60Hz laptop displays (such as MacBook Air or office laptops), on high-refresh monitors (120Hz, 144Hz, 240Hz+), or in co-op sessions with friends, UltraSmooth keeps game simulation and animations running at their authentic 1.0x speed while eliminating micro-stutters, particularly in heavily modded setups (SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp).

[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]⚡ The Performance Duo: Combo with PureBinarySave[/b][/size]
[/center]

[quote]
For the ultimate smooth playthrough, pair this mod with its sister companion [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54266]PureBinarySave[/url] [/b]:
[list]
[*][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971]UltraSmooth[/url] [/b]optimizes the rendering engine: uncapped high-refresh rates (144Hz+), frame pacing, frustum culling, and zero-stutter gameplay.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54266]PureBinarySave[/url] [/b]optimizes the I/O pipeline: eliminating bedtime save black-screen freezes and title-screen loading delays.[/*]
[*]They communicate seamlessly with each other to guarantee maximum smoothness with zero frame drops.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]🚀 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Refresh Rate & Physics Pacing (60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz+ / Uncapped):[/b] Paces game simulation (NPC pathing, monsters, tree falls, debris, projectiles, animations) to consistent 60 TPS natural speed while rendering at your display's refresh rate with lower input latency.[/*]
[*][b]Adaptive 60Hz Variable Timestep:[/b] On 60Hz displays, [b]Enhanced60[/b] and [b]MonitorHz[/b] engage variable timestep with VSync to prevent MonoGame's catch-up frame skipping and avoid 30 FPS drops during momentary frame dips on heavy modded farms.[/*]
[*][b]High-FPS Animation Timing Fixes:[/b] Resolves vanilla timer truncation issues at high framerates so Clint's geode cracking, fishing rod cast timing, and holding caught items continue running at normal 1.0x speed without slow-motion.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Ground Item & Debris Optimizer:[/b] Employs spatial partitioning ([i]PackedCellSpatialGrid[/i]) and physics sleeping for resting ground items. Nearby loose drops smoothly merge into clusters with optional overhead star-quality badges, reducing CPU overhead during large harvests or mining runs.[/*]
[*][b]Faster Transition Fades:[/b] Optionally speeds up normal screen fades during door and map transitions (configurable from 2.0x to 5.0x, or turned off), while leaving story cutscenes, festivals, and night transitions at their normal speeds.[/*]
[*][b]SmoothMenuStreamer (Lazy Tab Streaming):[/b] Instantiates heavy GameMenu tabs ([i]Skills[/i], [i]Social[/i], [i]Crafting[/i], [i]Animals[/i], [i]Collections[/i]) on-demand when clicked, eliminating the initial stutter when opening the menu (E / Esc).[/*]
[*][b]Co-op Network Buffer Expansion (Direct-IP / LAN / VPN):[/b] Expands Lidgren UDP socket buffers from 128 KB to 1,024 KB (1 MB) to help prevent connection drops when loading large modded farms. Improves player position updates and smoothing, completely bypassed in single-player.[/*]
[*][b]Responsive Mouse Polling:[/b] Samples hardware mouse state just before drawing, reducing software cursor latency for snappy, responsive mouse movement.[/*]
[*][b]Sub-Frame Sprite Motion Interpolation:[/b] Smooths character and entity movement between simulation ticks on high-refresh monitors.[/*]
[*][b]Off-Screen Critter & Terrain Culling:[/b] Skips drawing off-screen critters, grass, and crops to save unnecessary draw calls on large maps.[/*]
[*][b]Ultrawide & High-Res House Renovation Camera:[/b] Expands camera boundaries and adds keyboard panning (WASD / Arrows) to Robin's renovation menu so ultrawide (21:9 / 32:9) and 4K screens can navigate the view properly.[/*]
[*][b]Background JIT Pre-Warming & Memory Coordination:[/b] Pre-warms runtime compilation in the background on the title screen and performs coordinated memory cleanups before saving to minimize saving pauses.[/*]
[*][b]SDV-Radiance & UI Info Suite 2 Compatibility:[/b] Normalizes shader clocks, cloud shadows, falling petals, and animal petting indicators to real-time speed.[/*]
[*][b]Performance Overlay (F7):[/b] Non-intrusive in-game FPS, frametime sparkline graph, RAM, and Monitor Hz diagnostic HUD.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration[/b][/size]
UltraSmooth fully supports both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] for in-game adjustments and live FPS mode switching.

[b]Framerate (FPS) Modes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]60 FPS (Standard):[/b] Standard vanilla 60 FPS fixed timestep with background optimizations active.[/*]
[*][b]60 FPS (Enhanced):[/b] Adaptive 60 FPS mode. On 60Hz displays, uses variable timestep with VSync to reduce catch-up stutter and avoid 30 FPS drops when frame rates momentarily dip. On >60Hz monitors (120Hz/144Hz/240Hz), locks to 60 FPS fixed timestep for lower power consumption.[/*]
[*][b]Monitor Hz (60 / 120 / 144 / 240Hz+):[/b] Matches your display's refresh rate with VSync, using variable timestep, 60 TPS simulation pacing, and sub-frame sprite interpolation.[/*]
[*][b]Unlimited (Uncapped):[/b] Uncapped framerate mode for benchmarking while preserving 60 TPS physics and animations.[/*]
[/list][i]Note: Automatically switches to safe 60 FPS Fixed TimeStep during story cutscenes and multiplayer co-op sessions to maintain animation timing and synchronization.[/i]

[line]

[size=5][b]❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)[/b][/size]

[b]Q: Does this work with multiplayer co-op? Do both Host and Client need to install it?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. UltraSmooth can be installed by either party or both:
[list]
[*]If [b]Client[/b] installs alone: Expands receive buffer to 1MB, helping prevent warp disconnects when entering large farms, and smooths movement locally.[/*]
[*]If [b]Host[/b] installs alone: Expands server socket buffer and broadcasts player movement at 60Hz.[/*]
[*]If [b]Both install:[/b] Full buffer expansion and 60Hz movement sync on both screens.[/*]
[/list][i]Note: Settings do not need to match between players; each client configures their own local broadcast and rendering preferences independently.[/i]

[b]Q: Is this a pixel upscaler or texture smoother like Clear Glasses / Monocle?[/b]
[b]A:No.[/b] UltraSmooth focuses on motion fluidity, high refresh rate pacing, input responsiveness, and background performance — not texture filtering or pixel art modification. It is 100% compatible to use alongside Clear Glasses or Monocle.

[b]Q: Does this work with large expansion mods (SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp)?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. UltraSmooth is specifically designed to alleviate garbage collection pauses, loading delays, and multiplayer warp disconnects in heavy modpacks.

[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] (v4.0.0 or newer).[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] to easily customize settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Download **UltraSmooth** and extract the [font=Courier New]UltraSmooth[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Press [b]F7[/b] in-game to toggle the performance overlay if desired.[/*]
[/list]
